rows.grounds: compound indicating a duration of ten thousand years; analyzed as fused form
name of the agent; nominative singular with sandhi from rāmaḥ
denotes the act of carrying out rule

items.question: What duration characterizes Rāma's exercise of sovereign kingship?
premises: Rāma is the named agent of the action.
The action performed is the exercise of kingship.
The stated duration of this kingship is ten thousand years.
items.inference: Rāma exercised sovereign kingship for ten thousand years.
items.plain_english: Rāma ruled the kingdom for ten thousand years.
